summary: New Complete-My-Day (Premium) feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_recommend.py — POST /api/ai/recommend returns proper {remaining, items[]} shape; focus='any' + only='all' returned >=3 meals + >=3 snacks; focus='vegetarian' returned only veg items (no chicken/beef/fish/etc. detected in name+description+ingredients); only='snacks' returned exclusively kind=='snack'; POST /api/ai/recommend/refine preserves the item id and 'Under 500 calories' + 'Higher in protein' both produce a valid single RecommendItem with recalculated macros (protein_g >= original for the higher-protein refine). Regression: full existing suite 11/11 passes in 12s (health, register/login/me, profile+Mifflin-St Jeor targets, meals CRUD, water/weight, dashboard, chat-sync, premium-toggle, scan-meal happy+fast-fail, delete-account). Frontend: mobile viewport 375x667 signed in via UI to a fresh premium+onboarded user. home-complete-day card visible below the Scan hero; tapping it as premium routes to /recommend, tapping it after toggling premium off routes to /paywall. On /recommend, rec-remaining shows 2259 kcal / 144g P / 279g C / 63g F for the fresh user; all 6 filter chips (any/high_protein/low_calorie/vegetarian/vegan/quick) render; 6 rec-card-* + 6 rec-talk-* + 6 rec-add-* rendered. Refine sheet opens with all 5 testIDs (refine-input, refine-send, refine-quick-0, refine-add, refine-close). refine-quick-0 ('Higher in protein') successfully calls the refine API and updates the card in place. Two minor pre-existing React Native web deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) surface in console but are non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — pre-existing, appears across screens. Non-blocking on native/web.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appears when opening the refine Modal. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Cosmetic/optional) Address pre-existing RN-web deprecations — migrate shadow* to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents. Not blocking for this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:869-885 _remaining_budgets correctly subtracts today's consumed macros from Mifflin-St Jeor targets and floors at 0 — verified against dashboard totals.

server.py:1010-1021 refine endpoint defensively unwraps AI JSON that may be nested under 'item' or 'items' and force-preserves inp.item.id — good defensive parsing; verified id stays unchanged across two refinements.
server.py:960-963 hard-filters items[] by kind for only='meals' / only='snacks' after the AI returns — makes the endpoint robust even if the model ignores the hint.

recommend.tsx:78-81 premium gate correctly redirects to /paywall via useEffect on user.premium — verified: toggling premium off and re-navigating to /recommend also redirects (in addition to the home-complete-day gate).
recommend.tsx:136-138 applyRefinement updates both items[] state and the active card in place — verified card macros update after refine-quick-0.
api.ts:110-123 recommend/refineRecommendation use 90s timeout + 1 retry which comfortably covers the 60s backend wait_for. Good.
seed_data_creation: Per-test module fresh premium user TEST_rec_<ts>@c1.app (backend) and TEST_ui_<ts>@c1.app (frontend). Both cleaned up via DELETE /api/auth/account at end of run.
